title: Productized model release playlist and comm sticker-sheet
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a single-source-of-truth release playlist for the new productized model variant (vp2-small-v1). Deliverables: release notes, one-page communications sticker-sheet for sales/CS, catalog entry with benchmarks, docs updates, telemetry gate definitions, and a staged rollout plan. Coordination across Eng, Design, Docs, Growth, Support, and Sales required. This ticket consolidates tasks and owners and produces final artifacts for the launch meal-delivery to internal stakeholders and external release channels.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog entry published with model tags, pricing tier, and compatible runtime variants
Release notes approved by PM and Legal and staged in release-notes repo
One-page sticker-sheet (PNG + printable PDF) approved by Design and distributed to Sales
Docs updated: quickstart, best-practices, and migration notes live in docs.redwood.ai
Benchmarks summary uploaded to telemetry dashboard and linked in catalog entry
Telemetry gates defined and committed; canary rollout automation configured in Deployments
All stakeholders have signoff recorded in approvals list
release_notes_draft: vp2-small-v1: New cost-efficient variant ideal for chat frontend and low-latency embeddings. Deliver 0.8x cost vs baseline with similar quality on our core prompt set. GA availability by region: US, EU. Known limitation: degraded long-context summarization beyond 4096 tokens. See benchmarks and suggested prompt patterns in docs.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (internal preview): 2025-08-22 - internal Sales/Support preview slot; usage cap 10k tokens/day
Phase 1 (canary): 2025-08-25 - 5% traffic to vp2-small-v1 routed by smart-routing policy; monitor latency and error-rate; rollback on breach
Phase 2 (ramp): 2025-08-27 - 25% traffic for 48 hours if telemetry gates pass
Phase 3 (GA): 2025-08-28 - enable for self-serve catalog with pricing tier applied; publish release notes and comms
telemetry_gates: Semantic quality regression on core eval set < 1.5% absolute
Cost per 1k tokens improvement >= 15% vs baseline when batching enabled
benchmarks_summary: Internal benchmark (n=12 workloads): latency P95 180ms (seq=256), throughput 220 tokens/sec per GPU instance, end-to-end quality delta vs baseline model: -0.8 BLEU-adapted metric on conversational set, embedding cosine similarity mean 0.994. Full CSV attached in attachments and uploaded to telemetry dashboard.
risks: Quality regression detected on long-form summarization
Unexpected latency increase under autofill/burst traffic
Docs out-of-date leading to support escalations
Pricing tier misconfiguration could lead to billing discrepancies
mitigation_steps: Add focused evals for long-form summarization before Phase 1; hold if regression > 1.5%
Enable per-route autoscale and temporary burst capacity; pre-warm canary nodes
Docs freeze and docpair review: Docs owner to run doc smoke tests against sample prompts
Billing validation run using synthetic customer accounts; finance signoff before GA
